affected_system: municipal capital planning, debt, grants, reserves, procurement, and asset delivery
alternatives: advance high-risk work within verified feasible windows for municipal capital project delivery schedule
use rolling risk and capacity updates to reschedule municipal capital project delivery schedule
pair funding, dependency, permit, procurement, season, and workforce scheduling with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Budgets, obligations, appropriations, encumbrances, expenditures, schedules, and assets are reconciled.
All fiscal scenarios separate nominal, real, committed, contingent, and modeled amounts.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue the fixed operating calendar for municipal capital project delivery schedule.

constraints.description: The capital portfolio and municipal finance schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief financial officer and capital planning director
decision_question: When should design, permitting, procurement, utility coordination, construction, and commissioning occur?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The capital portfolio and municipal finance schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for municipal capital project delivery schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: funding, dependency, permit, procurement, season, and workforce scheduling
independence_key.primary_outcome: priority project-days beyond service and compliance milestones

intended_claim: A versioned schedule design for comparing declared alternatives affecting municipal capital project delivery schedule, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: priority project-days beyond service and compliance milestones
distributional gap in priority project-days beyond service and compliance milestones
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a project schedule authorized, contracted, under construction, or complete.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for municipal capital project delivery schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.

title: Schedule capital procurement and delivery
transportability_risks: Accounting, tax authority, debt limits, grants, procurement, labor, and markets differ.
Historical delivery and cost relationships may shift under inflation or policy change.
